sources.snippet: Vibrato Emotion Analysis — Expanded Study Research Question: Does the presence of vibrato in vocal performance measurably alter AI-perceived emotional dimensions? This is an expanded replication and extension of the original vibrato emotion analysis project, featuring cross-model validation, richer visualizations, and formal statistical testing.
